question: According to Article 166, in whose name will all executive proceedings of a State Government be expressed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Governor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** Article 166**

 
 
• Article 166 of the Constitution of India deals with the conduct of business of the Government of a state:
 
• All executive action of the state government must be taken in the name of the Governor.
 
• The Governor makes rules for the transaction of state government business and allocates it among ministers.
 
• Orders and instruments made in the name of the Governor are authenticated in a manner specified by the Governor's rules. 
 
 
 
• **Governor**
 
 
• The Governor of a state in India is appointed by the President of India.
